approach: Add optional specRef to StepBase/QuestionModule, populate manifest + a sample of question modules, add a pure checkSpecRef completeness check, export manifest.specref.json via a pnpm-test-time script, extend spec-traces buildDriftIssueBody/report to read it. Every extension point mirrors an existing pattern in the codebase.

plan.summary: Annotate steps/question-modules with specRef, add a completeness check, bridge to spec-trace via a generated JSON artifact (never a direct import)
plan.key_finding: Every piece of this feature mirrors an existing pattern already in the codebase - flowRefs field shape, checkInputsSatisfiableFromManifest pure-check shape, buildDriftIssueBody/report hook points - no new architecture needed

decisions.decision: Generate manifest.specref.json via a pnpm-test-time script rather than a build plugin
decisions.why: Ties artifact freshness to the command CI already runs on every PR (pnpm test) rather than the heavier, less-frequent pnpm build; satisfies FR-007s module-boundary constraint since it is pure data generation via tsx, no bundler needed
decisions.rejected: A Vite build plugin emitting the artifact during pnpm build
